title: raddist
intro: The ’raddist’ component calculates the radiation distribution in the canopy.

sections.text:
Sun-shade model of radiation distribution in the canopy.
   Used by bioclimate SSOC raddist (see 19.5, page 116) .
  < "sun-shade" (sigma PAR 0.15 [])
                    (sigma NIR 0.83 [])
                    (Ps PAR 0.1 [])
                    (Ps NIR 0.18 [])
                    (Ps PAR SWE Ps PAR SWE ) ; Has default value.
                    (Ps NIR SWE Ps NIR SWE ) ; Has default value. >
    sigma PAR: number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.15)
     Leaf scattering coefficient of PAR. sigma PAR=0,15 (Houborg, 2006)
    sigma NIR: number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.83)
     Leaf scattering coefficient of NIR. sigma NIR=0,83 (Houborg, 2006)
    Ps PAR: number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.1)
     Soil reflection coefficient of PAR, Ps PAR = 0.1 (Houborg, 2006)
    Ps NIR: number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.18)
     Soil reflection coefficient of NIR, Ps NIR = 0.18 (Houborg, 2006)
    Ps PAR SWE : plf [pF → <none>]
     Parameter (has default const value 1 [])
     Effect of soil water on Ps PAR.
    Ps NIR SWE : plf [pF → <none>]
     Parameter (has default const value 1 [])
     Effect of soil water on Ps BIR.
